verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's task model (docs-5) and workflow-phase selection (docs-6, docs-10) show that a task is created and can be routed through 'Oneshot' for small clear changes or heavier RPI/PRD-oriented flows for ambiguous work, and RPI sub-agents (docs-9) imply a research→plan→implement pipeline that turns a description into a scoped plan. However, there is no explicit walkthrough showing a raw plain-language bug/feature description being automatically parsed into a scoped implementation task end-to-end, and integrations (Jira/Linear/GitHub) mostly create tasks from existing tickets rather than free-form language input. Missing for 10: a concrete example or tutorial of plain-language-to-scoped-task conversion, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this pipeline works as described.
